changelog.text: Added Smart Auto Download, Voice Search, and Deep Link sharing for a smarter music experience.
Introduced Equalizer, Bass Boost, DSP Audio Engine, and Audio Output device selection.
Added premium animations, achievement cards, high-resolution artwork, and new interactive UI components.
Completely redesigned Mobile and Android TV UI with improved navigation, responsiveness, and remote controls.
Enhanced playback, API performance, loading speed, animations, memory usage, and overall app stability.
Improved Watch Party synchronization, real-time chat, typing indicators, and session management.
Fixed multiple playback, UI, TV focus, API, and stability issues across the app.
